Please run each command separately OR chain them into a single command via && or ;

# I can try to manually copy the joblib package from venv to 3.12 site-packages, 
# but it might not be compatible.
# A better way: install it using pip with --target.
(2) /usr/local/bin/python3.12 -m pip install --target /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages joblib
